name: Subway ride
source:
Basically, you are on a subway in buenos aires and when you are about to faint, you encounter a woman whom you have a nice conversation with. 

[From [url=https://zejbo32.itch.io/subway-ride]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
简单来说，你正乘坐布宜诺斯艾利斯的地铁，快要晕倒时遇见了一位女士，并与她愉快地聊了起来。

[摘自[url=https://zejbo32.itch.io/subway-ride]Itch.io[/url]]
